Every word you say is a fossil.
Window. Old Norse: vindauga. A wind-eye.
Companion. Com, panis. The one you share your bread with.
Muscle. Musculus. A little mouse, moving under the skin.
Disaster. Dis, astro. A bad star.
Clue. A ball of thread. The one that led Theseus out of the labyrinth.
Salary. From sal: salt. Were Roman soldiers really paid in salt? Probably not. But the salt stayed in the word.
Brain rot. Word of the year, twenty twenty-four. First written down by Thoreau... in eighteen fifty-four.
Every word you say is a fossil. Some of them, you're laying down right now.
